entry.title: AI hedge fund Situational Awareness may have sold its public portfolio, but it still has its Anthropic shares
entry.summary: The former OpenAI researcher’s fund was forced to unwind public equities after leveraged public bets plummeted. But he still has cards to play.

entry.title: Marathon Asset Management on Hyperscalers’ Credit Risks
entry.summary: Bruce Richards, Managing Partner and Head of CVC Marathon discusses the current state of credit markets and the cost of capital. With $80 billion in assets under management and extensive Wall Street experience, Richards provided valuable perspectives on market dynamics and financing conditions. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Emily Graffeo on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Banks Line Up $15 Billion of Debt for Anthropic With Google Aid
entry.summary: Banks led by Morgan Stanley are in talks to line up $15 billion of debt for an Anthropic PBC data-center project in Texas, backstopped by Alphabet Inc.’s Google, according to people familiar with the matter.

entry.title: Goldman Says Microsoft Shows How Its AI Bet Pays Off
entry.summary: Microsoft Corp. is giving investors clearer signs that it has multiple ways to turn its artificial-intelligence investment into revenue, Goldman Sachs Group Inc. analyst Gabriela Borges said, as the shares surged the most in almost 18 years.

entry.title: Microsoft's Goldilocks AI Quarter
entry.summary: Microsoft's blockbuster earnings sparked a major rally as TD Cowen's Derrick Wood joins Bloomberg TV to explain why this was the perfect "Goldilocks" quarter. From accelerating Azure growth and improving AI economics to surging Copilot adoption, here's why Wall Street believes Microsoft's AI story is getting even stronger. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.summary: London-based Inforcer just closed a $50 million Series C round led by Insight Partners.

entry.title: Apple’s Earnings Will Test Stock’s Status as the AI Safety Play
entry.summary: Wall Street’s sudden aversion to AI spending has made Apple Inc. this year’s Big Tech stock market star. But the iPhone maker’s earnings after the close Thursday could remind investors of the hurdles it still faces.

entry.title: Pakistan’s Fintech Abhi Plans Microfinance Bank IPO This Month
entry.summary: Pakistan’s fintech group Abhi is preparing to launch an initial public offering of its microlender this month, according to its founder, as it seeks to capitalize on the nation’s busiest year for listings.

entry.title: Goldman Pitches $5.4 Billion Debt for Microsoft-Tied Data Center
entry.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. is gauging investor appetite for a potential $5.4 billion debt offering to help fund a Blackstone-backed QTS data center tied to Microsoft Corp., as bubble concerns push up costs for artificial intelligence infrastructure financings.

entry.title: SK Hynix Slips Ahead of Big Tech Results | Bloomberg Tech 7/29/2026
entry.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down why SK Hynix's Korean shares slumped even after reporting a six-fold jump in profit and raised capital spending to a record $31 billion. Plus, SoFi CEO Anthony Noto joins following the company's earnings topping Wall Street estimates, but showing high expenses; and big tech earnings are on the docket, with Microsoft and Meta coming next. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Battery Storage Startup Antora Closes $550M Series C In One Of Year’s Largest Cleantech Rounds
entry.summary: Amid soaring energy demand from AI data centers, Antora says it will use its new capital to speed up deployment of “large-scale” projects across the country.

entry.title: Goldman Says Japan’s AI Stock Trade ‘Not Broken’ After Rout
